text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after the fierce battle of the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "—Ever since the Derby, Tanino Gimlet has suddenly vanished from the media eye! Where could she be now, and what is she doing...?!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "There's a lot of speculation flying around among the fans about this topic, but... what do our studio guests think?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it was a pretty packed rotation.
Maybe she's entering a recharge period for the autumn?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"That said, considering how strongly Gimlet ran
and showed us all what she's made of,
there's no doubt she'll achieve great success from autumn onward!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, she possesses a unique charm unlike any other Umamusume!
She has a dedicated fanbase, and truth be told, I myself—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Japan Derby, the attention on Tanino Gimlet
has continued to rise, and people are turning their passionate gazes toward her future...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it was a situation where people had
even higher expectations for Tanino Gimlet's future
than for Symboli Kris S's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To truly imprint Symboli Kris S's strength onto everyone,
perhaps we need to show them even greater "results"...
choice_data_list: (...I need to discuss this with Kris S.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, I was about to discuss
future goals with Symboli Kris S, when—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Suggestion.
...Regarding our goals, I have a proposal... something to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something, wrong—
choice_data_list: Actually... I wanted to ask your advice too.
Actually... I wanted to ask your advice too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After quickly comparing notes,
it seemed Symboli Kris S had also judged that
things couldn't go on like this for the same reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Gimlet displayed that vivid... a "potential"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"We must—rewrite it.
We must show results that surpass it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I want to hear—your opinion.
The "results" we seek—
In which race—do they lie?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In my mind, I had originally set my sights
on entering the Kikuka Sho,
the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 'results' likely gained there will undoubtedly
help in accomplishing the mission. However—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What's demanded right now is a far more vivid 'result'...
one that transcends the confines of the Classic division and shakes the very era."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After thinking this far, one race
surfaced in my mind as the answer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I declare "it" boldly, without hesitation or doubt,
just like Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...To compete against the Senior Class--
the pinnacle of medium-distance races--

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Do you have a plan to win?
choice_data_list: ...It's going to be an extremely tough race

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Naturally. This race gathers the absolute highest echelon of Senior-class Umamusume, all possessing vast amounts of experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so—
it wasn't a proposal made without any chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From the races up to today, I have full confidence that Symboli Kris S is experiencing dramatic growth right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At this rate, she's sure to have built up enough strength to go toe-to-toe with the Senior class by the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, before considering our chances of victory, in order to fulfill my mission—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Simply entering the race is meaningless. Only when she, a Classic-class runner, blows past the seasoned veterans and claims victory will it truly be the "result" we seek.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why I steeled my resolve and said, "We have no choice but to win."
As her Trainer, I will follow her lead and be strong—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I'm going to run now.
—2,000 meters—with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Watch me――and see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Heh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Watching Symboli Kris S start running,
I realized immediately. She wasn't simply
sprinting 2,000 meters at full power."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Disciplining herself, storing up power, waiting for the right
moment to unleash it. It is almost as if—
she were racing against an invisible opponent."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unleashed past the final corner, her late-stage burst was so fierce it seemed ready to wipe away the phantom images of the other Umamusume in her sight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It closely mirrored the style of running
I had secretly envisioned her striving for
in order to claim victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had only just envisioned it, though...
Naturally, I haven't told her yet.
So how could Symboli Kris S possibly—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —We think the same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That I can't stay—as I am now—
And that I thought the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)'—would be the breakthrough—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Believing that I had to win...――
Analyzing that my chances of victory...――
Lay at 2000m...――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's all the same.
...The thoughts of my Trainer, and mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I—just ran.
...I showed them that I can run."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Because I thought... that was the best way—
to show my consent—and my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Fight me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Please... help me perfect this run.
In order to win... the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —In order to fulfill my mission.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She once told me
that 'being different is necessary and important.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By bringing together our different perspectives, we can walk the same path—
she affirmed me, even though our paces were different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It is true that I was given courage back then. But right now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Realizing that Symboli Kris S and I shared the exact same thoughts and resolve made a fiery passion swell within my chest...!
choice_data_list: Let's go. To the Tenno Sho (Autumn). To win!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With our hearts as one, we began advancing toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Together with her, I have to forge our running form
into an even stronger shape to secure victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...At last, I found you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—just like a bloodhound.
I must commend you for finding me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In praise of you taking my back,
I shall hear you out.
What is it you desire, appearing before me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I simply... came to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will—run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Oho...! Heheh, well now—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"So the next stage machinery is set in motion, is it?
...And why, pray tell, are you informing me of this?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: For some reason... I felt that I had to... tell you." blow

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Is that yet another inner cry?
Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever. We'll find out soon enough, myself included.
Either way, you've—'begun', haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Walk your own path, Kris S. Give this world
as much amusement as you can——

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Gimlet.
You are...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Why are you now... so... cold...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...
Symboli Kris S's summer was about to begin—
